F5 · A list inside a widget
S1 · A selected node on the canvas
S2 · How a palette item lands
S4 · The inspector with none or several selected

annotations.text: Nine boards, five directions each, a recommendation on every one. Pick by letter and leave notes beside the board — your notes outrank the recommendation. F1–F5 (row 1) came out of proving the document renders like scene.tsx; S1–S4 (row 2) are the editor screen’s open questions. Each pick becomes a rule in Admin.md §6.5c before code.

Not on these boards: full views as pages (decided: Design-System.md §8.4; the adapter already returns them), the rev conflict rule (decided: Admin.md §6.4, refused not merged), and the inspector controls themselves (decided and built on the previous canvas).
